```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pe " <!ENTITY ent 'parameter entity value'> ">
  %pe;
  <!ENTITY base "Resolved &ent;">
  <?target-pi data="processing instruction content"?>
]>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/sub">
  <!-- Top-level comment containing markup-like chars <>&"' -->
  <sub:child sub:attr="value">
    <?another-pi test="123"?>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block inside namespaced element with <tags> & entities &base;
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE testDoc [
  <!ELEMENT testDoc (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % extDtd SYSTEM "http://example.com/does-not-exist.dtd">
  %extDtd;
  <!ENTITY dynamic "& nested entity &base;">
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
]>
<testDoc xmlns="http://xml.org/base" xmlns:ext="http://xml.org/ext">
  <!-- Section comment with multi-line
       description and special characters -->
  <ext:section ext:id="S1">
    <?target-pi data="param"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Nested CDATA with <tag> and & references inside ext namespace.
    ]]>
  </ext:section>
</testDoc>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item+)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "First Entity">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "&ent1; and Second Entity">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
  <?custom-pi action="init" status="active"?>
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.org/catalog" xmlns:x="http://example.org/x">
  <!-- Comment in catalog root -->
  <x:item x:code="001">
    <?x:pi target="refresh"?>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA containing unescaped <brackets>, &ersands;, and quotes '"
    ]]>
    &ent2;
  </x:item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (node)*>
  <!ELEMENT node (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY localEnt "Local Entity Content">
  <?xml-client mode="safe" debug="true"?>
]>
<document xmlns="urn:document:root" xmlns:n="urn:document:node">
  <!-- Comment with boundary cases: -->
  <!-- ---- -->
  <n:node n:name="test-node">
    <?n:pi-target instruction-data?>
    <![CDATA[
      <!DOCTYPE nested-cdata-lookalike>
      <node>This is CDATA with markup inside.</node>
    ]]>
    &localEnt;
  </n:node>
</document>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY eA "Entity A">
  <!ENTITY eB "&eA; &eC;">
  <!ENTITY eC "Entity C">
  <?xml-app-info name="fuzzing-test" version="2.0"?>
]>
<root xmlns="http://test.org/ns/root" xmlns:ns1="http://test.org/ns/child">
  <!-- Complex comment block with DTD references: &eA; -->
  <ns1:child ns1:attribute="test">
    <?ns1:pi command="execute" arg="value"?>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block evaluating entities literally: &eA; &eB;
    ]]>
  </ns1:child>
</root>
